extracted.intended_audience: general readers and students of Victorian humorous fiction; creative writers studying narrative and satire
extracted.subtask_description: A chapter from a Victorian-era comic fairy-tale / satirical children's narrative (Thackeray-style) recounting adventures of Rosalba, Prince Giglio, and associated episodic incidents. Useful for readers, literary study, or writers analyzing 19th-century narrative voice and humor.
